Three Immigration Scoops Hidden in Plain Sight (by Pablo Manríquez). USCIS wants your social media handles, your mother's Social Security number, and your boss's tax ID. Plus, a new CRS report shows most asylum cases just disappear.

Maryland Karen Faces Felony Shadow After ICE Abducts Six Roofers Just Before $10,000 Payday (by Pablo Manríquez). Witnesses say Karen Trevino threatened to call ICE if workers returned to collect. Maryland law says that's extortion. A viral video is making it very hard to look away.

SCOOP: USCIS Cracks Open a Long-Closed Door for Foreign Nurses (by Pablo Manríquez). A federal approval buried in the Friday Federal Register could reshape how tens of thousands of internationally trained nurses enter the American health care workforce.

Gay Russian Dissident Survives ICE Detention. Now He's Talking. (EXCLUSIVE)  (by Pablo Manríquez). Maksim Borisov spent 13 months in the Eloy ICE Detention Center in Arizona where he saw unspeakable acts of cruelty and malice, especially against the LGBTQ community. This is his story.

SCOOP: Ayanna Pressley Forces Floor Vote on Haitian TPS (by Pablo Manríquez). House Democrats — with a critical assist from two Republicans — just stripped Speaker Johnson of his ability to bury Haiti TPS.

Two Guys Walk Into Congress With a Deal Nobody Asked For — But Everybody Needs (by Pablo Manríquez). With the Senate and House both punting, Reps. Fitzpatrick and Suozzi introduced the only immigration bill in either chamber with actual teeth.

A $12 Million Vote for ICE That Marni Von Wilpert Doesn't Want You to Remember (by Pablo Manríquez). While hundreds of San Diegans pleaded for protection from ICE surveillance, their councilmember signed the check and called their fears theoretical.

The Man Who Prosecuted "Many, Many People" Now Wants Their Votes (by Pablo Manríquez). Ryan Crosswell spent three years doing Trump's immigration dirty work in San Diego. Now he's asking Latino families in Allentown to send him to Congress.

A U.S. Citizen Held His Phone to the Mic. His Wife Was Calling from Inside ICE Detention. (by Logan Johnson). Gabriela Sousa called her own rally from Baker County Detention Center. Her husband Brandon Garrison called it what it is: a system designed to make people give up and leave.

DHS Funding Talks Collapse (Again) in Senate (by Pablo Manríquez). Watch now | GOP objections to TSA funding and an erratic White House negotiation leave long lines at airports and rogue immigration agents in the streets (video from last week)
Safe To Fly Undocumented? Lawmakers Say No. (by Pablo Manríquez)

Minnesota Sues Trump Administration Over ICE Killings — And a Car Sitting Shrink-Wrapped in a Warehouse (by Pablo Manríquez). The state wants a federal judge to force DOJ and DHS to hand over evidence in the deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti—including a shrink-wrapped car sitting untouched in a Brooklyn Center warehouse.
Nobody Likes Stephen Miller. The Numbers Finally Prove It. (by Pablo Manríquez). New polling average puts Miller at dead last in popularity for government officials across the political spectrum.
BREAKING: Nashville Journalist Estefany Rodriguez Released From ICE Detention  (by Pablo Manríquez). An immigration judge had ordered her release on bond days ago. ICE fought it. She's out anyway.

Jessica Craven discusses the importance of birthright citizenship outside the Supreme Court, emphasizing that individuals born in the United States belong here. She expresses her support for those who question their place, reinforcing the principles of the 14th amendment. This discussion provides a compelling perspective on constitutional law and us citizenship.
